text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"three clear benefit paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into distinct paragraphs that build the case in a clear, easy-to-follow order."},{"evidence":"fuel savings, flexibility, and safety are developed separately","quality":"idea development","description":"It explains each main claim with multiple supporting details instead of stopping at a brief assertion."},{"evidence":"uses counterargument and rebuttal about boredom and in-car systems","quality":"argumentation","description":"The essay acknowledges an opposing concern and answers it, which makes the position more persuasive."},{"evidence":"“If companies continue to develop driverless cars...” closing","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by restating the claim and summarizing the reasons in a purposeful final paragraph."},{"evidence":"“The text states...” repeated with article-based support","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay consistently anchors its claims in evidence from the source rather than relying mainly on opinion."}]}
